sloka: अद्य राममितः क्षिप्रं वनं प्रस्थापयाम्यहम् ।यौवराज्ये च भरतं क्षिप्रमेवाभिषेचये ॥२-९-२॥
transliteration: adya rāmamitaḥ kṣipraṁ vanaṁ prasthāpayāmyaham ।yauvarājye ca bharataṁ kṣipramevābhiṣecaye ॥2-9-2॥

translations.english: Today I shall at once banish Rama from here into the forest and get Bharata coronated as heirapparent without delay.
